bull_case: Bull assumes cyber-resilience plus Agent Cloud create multiple durable growth vectors and owner FCF/share reaches $45 in year 10. Under the locked 25x terminal multiple this produces about $563/share, but requires exceptional execution and dilution control.
bear_case: Bear assumes ARR growth decelerates sharply, SBC remains economically heavy and operating leverage improves slowly. Owner FCF/share reaches only $3.50 in year 10; the locked 15x terminal multiple produces about $31.58/share.
thesis: At the frozen $106.71 close, locked-policy DCF gives Bear/Base/Bull values near $31.58/$169.29/$563.05. Price/Base is 0.6304, but Base is fragile: roughly 81% of operating value is terminal and it assumes owner FCF/share rises from negative territory to $16. Under the same Base path and 20x terminal multiple, stopping at year 7 gives about $103.63, so current price is roughly consistent with seven years of the Base cash-flow ramp rather than the full ten-year path. This is a model inference, not an observable market forecast.

evidence.claim: Q2 FY2027 revenue was $427.260M, up 38% y/y, Subscription ARR was $1.660903B and management reported ARR growth of 33% y/y.
evidence.source: SEC 10-Q filed 2026-09-01 and Rubrik Q2 FY2027 official results published 2026-08-27

evidence.claim: H1 FY2027 OCF was $158.535M, property/equipment capex $9.876M, capitalized internal-use software $9.374M and SBC $174.386M. Frozen TTM arithmetic gives company-style FCF about $286.242M but an owner-FCF stress proxy after SBC of about -$55.521M.
evidence.source: SEC FY2026 10-K plus FY2027 Q2 and prior-year Q2 10-Q; downstream arithmetic

evidence.claim: At 2026-07-31 cash plus short-term investments were $1.747649B and convertible notes carrying value was $1.132895B, leaving about $614.754M of balance-sheet net cash before other adjustments.
FY2027 company guidance is revenue $1.685B-$1.693B, Subscription ARR $1.880B-$1.885B, FCF $323M-$333M and approximately 228M weighted-average shares.
evidence.source: Rubrik Q2 FY2027 official results published 2026-08-27

evidence.claim: Locked 9%/10-year DCF with net cash/share $2.6963 and 15x/20x/25x terminal multiples yields Bear $31.58, Base $169.29 and Bull $563.05. Base terminal value is about 81.1% of operating value.
evidence.source: Harness deterministic valuation policy and EV scenario inputs

evidence.claim: Using the Base owner-FCF/share ramp but capitalizing at year 7 with the same 20x terminal multiple gives about $103.63/share, close to the frozen $106.71 price. This is a duration sensitivity, not a claim about investor consensus.
evidence.source: EV duration sensitivity using locked Base path

counterevidence: The Base case assumes an aggressive transition from negative SBC-adjusted owner FCF to $16/share in year 10; the apparent discount disappears quickly if that cash-conversion ramp is delayed.
About 81% of Base operating value and 85% of Bull operating value comes from terminal value, making the valuation highly sensitive to long-run margins, dilution and terminal multiples.

FY2027 company FCF guidance excludes stock-based compensation as an economic owner cost; RBRK's current cash generation therefore looks materially stronger under conventional FCF than under the owner-FCF stress definition used here.
RBRK has only traded publicly since 2024, so there is no meaningful five-year public valuation percentile to corroborate the DCF signal.
unknowns: Normalized long-run SBC as a percent of revenue and the resulting diluted share count.
Agent Cloud revenue, margins, retention and customer-payback evidence are not separately disclosed.
How quickly material-right revenue effects disappear from reported growth comparability.
Long-run gross-margin and sales-efficiency ceiling after international expansion.
The economic effect of the 2030 convertible notes under sustained high share prices.
falsifiers: Cut Base materially if Subscription ARR growth falls below 20% before owner FCF/share turns sustainably positive after SBC.
Cut Base if diluted economic share count grows above 5% annually for two consecutive years without commensurate per-share cash growth.
Raise the durability case only if owner FCF/share turns positive while ARR growth remains above 25% and retention stays above 115%.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Frozen price $106.71 is far below the locked Bull value of about $563.05. The defined veto requires current price to exceed the Bull value, which is not satisfied.

key_kpis.name: SBC-adjusted owner FCF/share
key_kpis.threshold: turn sustainably positive and progress toward Base path

next_checks: Reconcile GAAP share count, RSUs/options and convertible dilution into a normalized economic diluted-share bridge.
Refreeze owner-FCF path after FY2027 year-end when full-year SBC and FCF are known.
Separate Agent Cloud economics and material-right normalization from core Rubrik Security Cloud growth.

Deterministic price/Base is about 0.6304, mapping directly to the configured <=0.7 score of 85.

Base operating value is about 81% terminal and starts from negative SBC-adjusted owner FCF. A long cash-conversion ramp, dilution normalization and 20x terminal multiple must all hold, fitting the 'very fragile' 25 anchor.

uncertainties.rationale: The low price/Base ratio is driven by a Base scenario with a steep owner-FCF/share ramp; it is not evidence that the stock is conventionally cheap.
Small delays in positive owner-FCF conversion materially reduce value because early cash flows are weak.
Terminal value dominates and dilution/SBC normalization is unresolved, so the valuation is highly assumption-sensitive.
